description: This PHP source file defines the 'CustomField' controller class within the Opencart admin namespace. The class contains methods that hook into custom field-related events—adding, editing, and deleting custom fields—and adds corresponding tasks to the system's task queue. The code subscribes to post-operation events triggered by models managing custom fields and adds tasks related to customer groups to a task model.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: Controller handling custom field events, adding tasks upon create, update, or delete operations.

methods.name: addCustomField
methods.description: Handles the event after a custom field is added; schedules tasks related to customer groups.

methods.name: editCustomField
methods.description: Handles the event after a custom field is edited; schedules tasks related to customer groups.

methods.name: deleteCustomField
methods.description: Handles the event after a custom field is deleted; schedules tasks related to customer groups.
